_note: The collector badges. build_collectors.py reads name, icon, color, rule and points from here; the logic for each id lives in the builder. Order here is the order on the badges tab. No dashes in any rule. tags label the artist's and the team's wallets on the board; they are ranked like everyone else.

badges.name: The Mayor
badges.rule: Number one on the board. One at a time, and it can change hands.

badges.name: Borough President
badges.rule: Hold 50 or more New Yorkers.

badges.name: Landlord
badges.rule: Hold 25 or more New Yorkers.

badges.name: Block Captain
badges.rule: Hold 11 or more New Yorkers. This release runs on eleven.

badges.name: Regular
badges.rule: Hold 5 or more New Yorkers. They know your order.

badges.name: Counted
badges.rule: Hold at least one New Yorker. You are in the census.

badges.name: Five Boroughs
badges.rule: Hold a New Yorker from Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and Staten Island.

badges.name: Bridge and Tunnel
badges.rule: Hold New Yorkers from three of the five boroughs.

badges.name: The Whole Family
badges.rule: Hold one of every family: Citizens, Builders, Degens, Heroes, Villains, Strays and the rest, all thirteen.

badges.name: The Whole Timeline
badges.rule: Hold a New Yorker from every era in THE CENSUS RELEASE.

badges.name: Time Traveler
badges.rule: Hold New Yorkers from five or more eras.

badges.name: Set Complete
badges.rule: Hold every piece of one set in THE CENSUS RELEASE. Each complete set also scores 10 points a piece.

badges.name: Started a Set
badges.rule: Hold three or more pieces of the same set.

badges.name: Local
badges.rule: Hold three or more New Yorkers from the same neighborhood.

badges.name: Keystone
badges.rule: Hold a KEYSTONE, one of the founding New Yorkers on Transient Labs.

badges.name: Founder
badges.rule: Hold a KEYSTONE and a piece of THE CENSUS RELEASE.

badges.name: Day One
badges.rule: Minted THE CENSUS RELEASE on 23 September 2026, the day it opened.

badges.name: First 111
badges.rule: Minted one of the first 111 tokens of THE CENSUS RELEASE.

badges.name: Lifer
badges.rule: Minted and never let a single New Yorker go.

badges.name: Moving Picture
badges.rule: Hold a New Yorker that moves: an animated piece.

badges.name: Glitched
badges.rule: Hold a New Yorker that carries a glitch edition.
